xna-type.name: IntermediateWriter
xna-type.summary: Provides an implementation of many of the methods of IntermediateSerializer including serialization and state tracking for shared resources and external references.
xna-type.remarks: A new instance of IntermediateWriter is constructed for each serialize operation.

method.name: WriteExternalReference
method.summary: Adds an external reference to the output XML, and records the filename to be serialized later.

overload.summary: Adds an external reference to the output XML, and records the filename to be serialized later.

type-parameters.type-parameter: The type of external reference to add.

method.name: WriteObject
method.summary: Writes a single object to the output XML stream.

overload.summary: Writes a single object to the output XML stream.

type-parameters.type-parameter: The type of value to write.

overload.summary: Writes a single object to the output XML stream, using the specified type hint.

type-parameters.type-parameter: The type of value to write.

method.name: WriteRawObject
method.summary: Writes a single object to the output XML stream using the specified serializer worker.

overload.summary: Writes a single object to the output XML stream using the specified serializer worker.

type-parameters.type-parameter: The type of value to write.

overload.remarks: This method does not write any type identifier, so it cannot support null or polymorphic values and the reader must specify an identical type while deserializing.

overload.summary: Writes a single object to the output XML stream as an instance of the specified type.

type-parameters.type-parameter: The type of value to write.

overload.remarks: If you specify a base class of the actual object value, only data from this base type will be written. This method does not write any type identifier, so it cannot support null or polymorphic values and the reader must specify an identical type while deserializing.

method.name: WriteSharedResource
method.summary: Adds a shared reference to the output XML and records the object to be serialized later.

overload.summary: Adds a shared reference to the output XML and records the object to be serialized later.

type-parameters.type-parameter: The type of value to write.

method.name: WriteTypeName
method.summary: Writes a managed type descriptor to the XML output stream.

overload.summary: Writes a managed type descriptor to the XML output stream.
